coverageCaveat: This pass did not produce a fully qualified new northern-quarter grooming/training premises. That does not establish absence of such businesses. Most discovered candidates lacked owner appointment evidence, carried stale/conflicting geography, or required a provider/source-policy decision. No missing tariff was invented or labelled unpublished merely because a menu was inaccessible. No veterinary treatment scope expansion and no business clones were used to satisfy the target.
